name: Enchanté Champagne Brunch Heirloom Tomato Tarte & Slow-Braised Pork Belly/Loin
brandOrRestaurant: Disney Treasure · Enchanté by Chef Arnaud Lallement (Brunch)
whyItWorks: Flaky French puff pastry and fork-tender braised pork are low-fiber, though tomato acidity and rendered pork fat require remission.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Eat the leanest portion of the braised pork and flaky pastry crust; skip the raw microgreen salad.
